product_one_liner.value: iVoyant’s Koodisi helps enterprises connect business systems and automate workflows through a no-code integration platform with built-in API management.

pricing_page.notes: Its Koodisi product has a public Enterprise plan page; prices are quoted rather than published.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn’s explicit company-size band. Its separate employee count is 85, so the available headcount signals conflict.

eng_blog.notes: Ayush Sharma explains PlatformNX Co-pilot agent routing, validation and orchestration; Carlos Gutierrez describes rebuilding mock APIs and refactoring a new project being built with iVoyant.

public_docs.notes: Koodisi documentation includes workflow, activity, API, AI, administration and operations guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live-readable AI/ML Engineer listing in Bengaluru; last updated November 5, 2026.

model_provider.notes: Koodisi documents activities that call the OpenAI REST API using the customer’s OpenAI credentials; this establishes a supported provider, not the undisclosed underlying provider of its built-in assistant.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn identifies iVoyant as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds; no round date or amount is reported.

raised_18mo.notes: No outside funding is reported. The funding profile’s displayed update is May 1, 2025; no later financing announcement was found for May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live-readable Bengaluru Sales Development Representative posting; it explicitly says the company is hiring to run outbound prospecting.

launched_6mo.notes: Koodisi v1.2.7 was released in October 2026 and introduces Agent Studio beta plus AI-assisted build, deploy and test capabilities, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small official team page was checked in full: its C-level leaders are Basanth Gowda and Sonya Beredimas. Profiles place their tenures before the window, in February 2014 and April 2018 respectively; no in-window departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly describes Apollo for lead data, LinkedIn for outreach and HubSpot for activity tracking. Other products are mentioned only as optional experience or integration capabilities, not established internal usage.
